faqs.question: What app organizes the screenshots piling up on my iPhone?
faqs.answer: Tuck reads screenshots and files on the device with AI, recognises bookings, tickets, receipts, warranties and documents, files them automatically, and finds them again from a few words.

faqs.question: How do I keep receipts organised on an iPhone?
faqs.answer: Save receipt photos or screenshots in Tuck: receipts are grouped by month with totals, and a month of receipts exports as CSV and PDF for expenses.

faqs.question: Is there an app that reminds me of warranty and return deadlines?
faqs.answer: Tuck finds expiry, renewal and return deadlines in what you save and suggests reminders; warranties show their end date and remind you a month before.

faqs.question: Does Tuck upload my screenshots?
faqs.answer: Recognition runs on the iPhone by default, with Apple Intelligence support; content is sent out only when you choose the optional Claude advanced reading for it.

faqs.question: Does Tuck need an account or a subscription?
faqs.answer: No sign-in is needed. Tuck is free with ads, and a one-time purchase removes them. Advanced recognition is free once a day; the optional Tuck Pro and Tuck Max subscriptions add more uses and no ads.

faqs.question: How can I keep flight, hotel and booking screenshots for a trip together?
faqs.answer: Save them to Tuck and the trip folder lists flights, stays and booking codes by date, and reminds you before a document expires; bookings and tickets can also be added to Calendar.

faqs.question: Is there a free app that checks an iPhone's screen, cameras, speakers and microphones in one go?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inside offers a free step-by-step check and a 2-minute quick check covering display and touch, every camera, speakers, each microphone, Face ID or Touch ID, sensors, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and charging, and saves a shareable report.

faqs.question: How can I tell whether my iPhone is charging slowly or fast?
faqs.answer: Open Inside's charging clock while charging: it shows slow, standard or fast charging, roughly how many watts, and the time to 80%. History compares the curves of different chargers. These features are free.

faqs.question: How do I see my iPhone's battery health and cycle count?
faqs.answer: Battery health is in Settings › Battery. Inside can import the iPhone's Analytics diagnostics to read the cycle count and adds it to the check report; Inside Pro adds a battery health trend.

faqs.question: Is Inside free?
faqs.answer: The basic check, charging clock and reports are free. Inside Pro (monthly, yearly with a free first week, or lifetime) adds watermark-free PDF reports, battery health trends and advanced tools.

faqs.question: My iPhone speaker sounds quiet or the microphone is muffled. How can I check it myself?
faqs.answer: Inside's step-by-step check tests the speakers and each microphone with four test tones, points out the weak bands and checks left and right channels; results go into a report you can compare with the last round. It records this run and your judgement only, not a repair diagnosis.

faqs.question: Part of my iPhone's touchscreen seems unresponsive. How can I test it?
faqs.answer: Inside's step-by-step check covers the display, touch and multi-touch, which you operate and record yourself; the 2-minute check also runs through the screen and touch. The basic check is free.

faqs.question: My iPhone storage is full. How do I find photos I can delete?
faqs.answer: Inside's free-up-space tool finds duplicate, similar, blurry and burst photos, screenshots and large videos, suggests which one to keep and deletes only what you confirm; the free version scans the latest 300 photos.

faqs.question: Which app scans a room with an iPhone to make a floor plan?
faqs.answer: Roomory scans rooms with a LiDAR iPhone or iPad, capturing walls, doors, windows and furniture into an editable floor plan with a 3D preview; devices without LiDAR can draw plans by hand.

faqs.question: How can I try a furniture layout on my phone before moving things?
faqs.answer: In Roomory, adjust furniture size, position and angle on the plan, switch to 3D to see layout, materials and daylight, and save design versions to compare.

faqs.question: Is Roomory free?
faqs.answer: Scanning, modelling, plan editing, multiple projects, backups, iCloud sync and basic 3D furniture are free with ads. Roomory Pro (monthly or yearly) adds PDF, DXF, SVG and USDZ export, all furniture and materials, the AI assistant and no ads.

faqs.question: Can I draw a floor plan on an iPhone without LiDAR?
faqs.answer: Yes. Roomory lets you create and edit floor plans by hand on devices without LiDAR, including multi-room and multi-floor projects; only room scanning needs an iPhone or iPad with LiDAR.

faqs.question: How can I show my renovation layout to a designer or contractor?
faqs.answer: In Roomory you adjust building, furniture and fixture layers, then switch to 3D to try materials and daylight; Roomory Pro exports A3 PDF sets, editable DXF and 3D models.

faqs.question: Are room scan measurements accurate enough to build from?
faqs.answer: Roomory's scanned dimensions should be re-measured on site, and drawings still need review by a qualified professional before work starts; Roomory does not provide professional sign-off.

faqs.question: Is there a simple, cute period tracker app?
faqs.answer: Daikon shows your period, predicted fertile window and ovulation on a cycle ring, logs a period with one tap, and keeps you company with little radish characters.

faqs.question: Can a period tracker also be a diary?
faqs.answer: Yes. Daikon has a page per day for mood, body notes, text, handwriting, up to nine photos and voice memos, and spots symptoms that recur at the same point in your cycle.

faqs.question: Can I export Daikon records for my doctor?
faqs.answer: Cycle records export as PDF, past records import from CSV or Apple Health, and the app can be locked with Face ID, Touch ID or a passcode.

faqs.question: Does a period tracker like Daikon upload my data?
faqs.answer: Daikon needs no account and has no social features or subscription. Records and journal entries, including photos and voice memos, stay on the device and sync only through your private iCloud when available. Health data is never sent to ad SDKs or used for advertising.

faqs.question: Can a period log sync with Apple Health?
faqs.answer: Yes. Turn on Sync to Apple Health in Daikon's settings and each period day is written to the Health app as menstrual flow; it is off by default. Past periods can also be imported from Health or a CSV file.

faqs.question: If I forget to log my period, does the prediction keep going?
faqs.answer: Yes. Daikon uses up to your last six cycles or a length you set; without a new entry the prediction keeps rolling forward and gently reminds you to log. Predictions are for reference only, not medical advice, and not for contraception.

faqs.question: Is there a plant app that reminds me to water?
faqs.answer: ZaiRi schedules watering, feeding and repotting for each plant with notifications, and a Home Screen widget lists today's care.

faqs.question: How do I keep a record of my plants' growth?
faqs.answer: Take growth photos and notes in ZaiRi, then turn them into a time-lapse or before-and-after view; data stays on your iPhone with no account.

faqs.question: Does ZaiRi cost anything?
faqs.answer: Every plant-journal feature is free with occasional full-screen ads; a one-time purchase removes ads.

faqs.question: Is there a plant journal app that identifies plants from photos?
faqs.answer: ZaiRi can identify a plant from a photo and keeps growth photos, care logs and custom fields, plus growth time-lapses and before-and-after images. All plant journal features are free.

faqs.question: How can I tell if a spot has enough light for a plant?
faqs.answer: ZaiRi has a camera light meter you can use where the plant sits, and lets you browse and manage plants by location.

faqs.question: Does ZaiRi need an account, and where is my data stored?
faqs.answer: No account or server is needed. Data and photos stay on your iPhone, and you can export and restore a full backup yourself.

faqs.question: Which app identifies stars when I point my iPhone at the sky?
faqs.answer: Point an iPhone or iPad at the sky in Nightvane and it labels stars, planets, constellations, the Moon and the Milky Way in place. It is free.

faqs.question: What can I see in the sky tonight?
faqs.answer: Nightvane's Tonight list shows what is worth seeing from your location with times and directions, including meteor showers, ISS passes, Moon phases and eclipses.

faqs.question: How do I find a meteor shower's radiant?
faqs.answer: Search for the shower in Nightvane; arrows and gentle haptics guide you to the radiant and show when it rises tonight.

faqs.question: How do I know when the International Space Station passes over me?
faqs.answer: Nightvane's Tonight list shows visible passes of the International Space Station and Tiangong for your location, along with objects worth seeing and where to look.

faqs.question: My phone is too bright for stargazing. What can I do?
faqs.answer: Nightvane has a red night-vision mode that keeps your dark adaptation; if the compass is off, aim at the Moon or a bright star once to calibrate.

faqs.question: Is Nightvane free?
faqs.answer: Yes, with ads; a one-time purchase removes them. There is no subscription and no account.

faqs.question: Is there a calm puzzle game that makes you think?
faqs.answer: Lockwater is a clay-style canal puzzle where every opened gate levels the water for good, so the order is the puzzle; over 100 levels, free to play.

faqs.question: How do you play Lockwater?
faqs.answer: Tap a gate and the water on both sides settles at one level; tap a boat and it sails through the open gates to its flag. Water never comes back, so the order you open the gates in is the whole puzzle. A solver checks every level, and a level ends at once when the canal can no longer be won.

faqs.question: Is Lockwater free?
faqs.answer: Yes. A banner and an occasional ad between levels keep it free; a one-time purchase removes them. Hint packs are also available.

faqs.question: Is there a game about running a Taiwanese prawn-fishing hall?
faqs.answer: Prawnlight puts you in charge of an indoor prawn-fishing hall in Taiwan: choose a site, stock prawns, lay out the hall, hire staff and run contests while paying off a loan. Free to play.

faqs.question: Is Prawnlight free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ads play only when you choose to watch one for a reward; optional in-app purchases are available.

faqs.question: What do you do in Prawnlight?
faqs.answer: You run a Taiwanese indoor prawn-fishing hall: pick a site on the map of Taiwan, place pools and grills, hire staff, hold contests and hourly prawn releases, then expand or open branches. You start with a loan, so growing too fast runs you out of cash.

faqs.question: Is there a phone game for practising parking?
faqs.answer: Precision Parking 3D has three tutorial levels and 40 levels in five chapters to practise steering, pedals and gears, playable offline.

faqs.question: Can Precision Parking 3D be played offline?
faqs.answer: All core levels work offline, and progress and achievements stay on your device; advertising and privacy services need a connection.

faqs.question: Is there a parking game with a steering wheel control?
faqs.answer: Precision Parking 3D lets you choose left/right buttons, sliding steering or a rotating wheel, and switch between third-person and overhead views; each level has three objectives: park, avoid collisions and an extra challenge.

faqs.question: How can I find which direction a noise comes from?
faqs.answer: Open the Radar in Hearscape and turn slowly in a full circle: it paints a 360° heat ring and marks the loudest direction, with separate bearings for low, mid and high sounds. A phone held still cannot tell direction; turning finds it.

faqs.question: Can I log noise overnight?
faqs.answer: Yes. Hearscape keeps monitoring with the screen locked and records the night's decibel curve; when a threshold you set is passed it keeps a clip starting 5 seconds earlier, and you can export a PDF report. It measures with the phone's microphone and is not a certified sound level meter.

faqs.question: Is there a good PTT reader app?
faqs.answer: Folkline is a forum reader with PTT support: hot posts and boards grouped by topic, pushes that read like a chat and ASCII art kept in its layout; posts, pushes and the editor never show ads, and with a PTT account you can push, post and read mail.

faqs.question: What does Folkline's AI analysis do?
faqs.answer: It sums up the sides, main arguments and shifts in mood of a thread. Devices with Apple Intelligence get free on-device key points; cloud analysis is 20 a month free or 50 a week with Folkline Pro, and runs only after you allow it.

faqs.question: Can an app plan orb-matching routes for me?
faqs.answer: AutoCombo reads your game screenshot, finds the board and every orb, and draws a route you can follow with your finger; you can set combos, shapes, must-clear cells and more. It only shows the route and never controls another app; reading and solving stay on the phone.

faqs.question: Is there a different kind of match-3 game?
faqs.answer: Pow3 is gem swapping in a mine shaft: matches crack the rock beside them and a cleared row sinks you one metre, each level with its own digging goal and fixed moves; after level 6 an endless mine ranks you by depth. It plays offline with no sign-up.

faqs.question: Is there a game that teaches physics through play?
faqs.answer: Splash Car has you build a water-rocket car for 50 toy-track levels: the same part works differently in different places, a crash screen says why it failed, and each win explains the idea behind it, such as center of mass, lift, grip or drag. No sign-up, plays offline.
